evidence_order: phone reader > full panels > matched tests > owner records > measurements > scripts > claims

nodes.symptom: Story events change or happen before their cause
nodes.frequency: 5 confirmed high-information cases in52; not an exhaustive failure rate
nodes.cause: 24 existing benchmark sources were assigned to revised chapter beats; some exact original requests contradict cast, body state or timing.
nodes.competing_hypothesis: Generator disobeyed a correct story prompt.
nodes.disposition: Not primary for these five: original source requests already describe the incompatible event. Other newly generated failures remain possible.
nodes.remedy: Storyboard-led source binding, independent semantic rejection and replacement of incompatible plates.
nodes.proof: Neutral14 panel source-to-beat review; zero unexplained actor/state/time/contact contradictions.

nodes.symptom: Excellent PASS scores coexist with visibly broken sequences
nodes.frequency: 52/52 hybrid rows share the same quality vector
nodes.cause: Workflow score presets, round-robin scenario tags and protected rectangles chosen around lettering replace independent observations.
nodes.disposition: Changing weights cannot rescue non-observational inputs.
nodes.remedy: Remove computed quality presets from decisions; independently freeze annotations and review actual phone sequence.
nodes.proof: Historical false-pass cases rejected despite valid hashes/JSON; two blind human reviews plus owner preference.

nodes.symptom: Large speech is readable in isolation but spills out of balloons or hides meaning
nodes.frequency: Confirmed P004/P005/P012/P033/P034 and matched sample; population count not established
nodes.cause: Type grew while curved container geometry and real-image protected regions were not jointly reviewed; authored boxes are not actual quiet space.
nodes.competing_hypothesis: Font size alone is too small.
nodes.disposition: Current actual362px minimum12.30px is above UI floor; visual containment/attribution still fails. Prior minimum was smaller.
nodes.remedy: Fit glyphs to real balloon interiors, real mouth targets and fixed image annotations; split/rewrite before shrinking.
nodes.proof: Zero visible glyph/body overflow or essential-feature occlusion at390; +30/+50percent copy stress with no smaller type.

nodes.symptom: Many panels feel like similarly finished dark fantasy illustrations
nodes.frequency: 35/52 declared low density but52 identical1024x1536 sources; visual sampling shows texture across quiet/action beats
nodes.cause: Full-frame asset production and repeated surface/lighting hierarchy give each beat comparable visual weight; median filtering cannot redesign shapes or acting.
nodes.disposition: Rejected: licensed later TOG and strong repository stills demonstrate useful detailed art. Density must serve attention and contrast.
nodes.remedy: Variable shot footprint, simpler backgrounds in emotional/action beats, explicit color script and selective detail; test cleaner separable route against well-directed current renderer.
nodes.proof: Blind review recognizes intended attention order and quiet/spectacle contrast; no proxy-only art threshold.

nodes.symptom: Coherent systems do not reliably create attachment or urgent action
nodes.frequency: Recurring in sampled early/late episodes; audience preference hypothesis, not survey result
nodes.cause: Theme and numerical reconciliation are clearer than personal stakes, expressive range and reward felt through action. Serious technical dialogue often replaces chemistry.
nodes.disposition: Unproven; owner strongly liked pilot and fault-reading/shared-cost engine supports original tactics.
nodes.remedy: Keep premise provisional; stage one relationship pressure and one capability change visibly, with state exposition only at decision/consequence.
nodes.proof: After route isolation, an Ember micro-opening is preferred/understood by owner and independent readers; story reset only after controlled rejection.

nodes.symptom: Large engineering surface produces limited visible quality returns
nodes.frequency: 603 legacy modules/76613 physical lines/317 validate modules in scoped count
nodes.cause: Hypothesis: copied evidence/validation machinery and record milestones may displace sequence-level revision. Actual time allocation and causal direction were not measured; difficult art may instead have prompted more machinery.
nodes.disposition: Rejected: hashes, preservation, nullable provenance, state ledgers, editable SVG and failure injection solve real problems.
nodes.remedy: Retain small proven core; consolidate only when pilot demands it, allocate explicit editorial correction time.
nodes.proof: Accepted-sequence quality and human correction hours, not module/report count, control scale.
